name: @luxfi/app
description: Lux Desktop & Mobile — thin brand wrapper over hanzoai/desktop (VITE_BRAND=lux)

scripts.init: git submodule update --init --recursive && pnpm -C desktop install
scripts.dev: VITE_BRAND=lux pnpm -C desktop nx serve hanzo-desktop
scripts.build: VITE_BRAND=lux pnpm -C desktop nx build hanzo-desktop
scripts.tauri:build: VITE_BRAND=lux pnpm -C desktop --filter hanzo-desktop tauri build
scripts.android: VITE_BRAND=lux pnpm -C desktop --filter hanzo-desktop tauri android build
scripts.ios: VITE_BRAND=lux pnpm -C desktop --filter hanzo-desktop tauri ios build
